steps.title: Analyze Build Failure
steps.description: Inspect the compilation log to identify the Android resource linking error caused by invalid XML attributes.

steps.title: Locate Layout XML Error
steps.description: Examine activity_main.xml and locate the root LinearLayout containing the incorrect width layout attribute 'match_match'.

steps.title: Fix Main Activity Layout Width
steps.description: Correct 'match_match' to 'match_parent' in the layout_width attribute of activity_main.xml to resolve AAPT compiler errors.

steps.title: Validate Remaining Layouts
steps.description: Scan and confirm that other project XML layout files utilize correct dimension and enumeration values.

steps.title: Verify Color Resources
steps.description: Validate colors.xml to verify correct color naming and hex code notations.

steps.title: Verify Application Themes
steps.description: Ensure style definitions conform to the system material guidelines and compile under native standards.

steps.title: Validate SQLite Schema and Queries
steps.description: Review DatabaseHelper.java implementation to prevent potential syntax errors during local compilation.

steps.title: Verify Manifest Declarations
steps.description: Verify namespace, application themes, standard activity paths, and launcher activity setups.

steps.title: Inspect Gradle Configurations
steps.description: Confirm that app/build.gradle matches the SDK compile target 34, compile options, and namespace setup.

steps.title: Building Inventory & Sales Manager
steps.description: Run the Gradle debug compilation sequence to assemble a stable, verified, and bug-free APK.
